name: FanXin 3x3 Octahedron
description: The FanXin 3x3 Octahedron is a striking twist on the classic cube, transforming the familiar 3x3 mechanism into an angular, geometric form. Its bold, tiled surfaces and eye-catching silhouette make it stand out on any shelf. Though it may look intimidating, it functions just like a standard 3x3, making it a great shape mod for solvers of all levels.
